> Hi [@aghzala-bx](https://github.com/aghzala-bx), we don't have an ETA for this feature, we're only tracking interest for now.
>
> If you want to give it a try for experimentation purposes, you can take a look at this userland example that handles injection of static and hits content here: https://codesandbox.io/s/injectedhits-react-instantsearch-hooks-tkye0g?file=/App.tsx.

We (premium plan customer) would love an updated version of a userland implementation to use with React InstantSearch 7
